per_question.question: En pacientes sometidos a un cateterismo cardíaco, ¿cuál es el primer valor de troponina medido después del procedimiento en cada episodio?
agent_sqls:
WITH proc AS (
  SELECT episode_ref, patient_ref, code, descr, start_date
  FROM g_procedures
  WHERE code IN ('37.21', '37.22')
),
lab AS (
  SELECT episode_ref, patient_ref, extrac_date, lab_descr, result_num, result_txt
  FROM g_labs
  WHERE lab_sap_ref IN ('LABTROPSU', 'LAB2967', 'LABTPNAS')
    AND result_num IS NOT NULL
),
joined AS (
  SELECT 
    proc.episode_ref,
    proc.patient_ref,
    proc.start_date,
    lab.extrac_date,
    lab.lab_descr,
    lab.result_num,
    lab.result_txt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY proc.episode_ref ORDER BY lab.extrac_date ASC) AS rn
  FROM proc
  JOIN lab ON lab.episode_ref = proc.episode_ref 
    AND lab.patient_ref = proc.patient_ref
    AND lab.extrac_date >= proc.start_date
)
SELECT episode_ref, patient_ref, start_date, extrac_date, lab_descr, result_num, result_txt
FROM joined
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY extrac_date ASC

per_question.question: Muestra, para cada episodio con paso por las UCIs 'E016', 'E103', 'E014', 'E015', 'E037', 'E057', 'E073' y 'E043' durante el año 2023, el tiempo en horas desde el inicio del movimiento hasta el inicio de la primera prescripción de nutrición enteral o parenteral central. Solo deben considerarse movimientos válidos (con duración mayor a 1 hora y dentro del rango de fechas 2023-01-01 a 2023-12-31), descartando aquellos cuyo `end_date` coincide con el `start_date` del siguiente movimiento del mismo episodio. Para cada episodio, se identifica la primera prescripción de nutrición ('NUTRICION ENTERAL' o 'NUTRICIÓN PARENTERAL CENTRAL') que caiga dentro del rango temporal del movimiento. La tabla debe contener una fila por episodio con nutrición dentro de la ventana, con las columnas: 'episode_ref' (número de episodio), 'start_date' (fecha de inicio del movimiento), 'start_drug_date' (fecha de inicio de la prescripción de nutrición), 'drug_descr' (tipo de nutrición: enteral o parenteral central) y 'hours_difference' (horas transcurridas desde el inicio del movimiento hasta el inicio de la prescripción).
agent_sqls:
WITH valid_movements AS (
    SELECT 
        m.episode_ref,
        m.patient_ref,
        m.start_date,
        m.end_date,
        m.ou_loc_ref,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.episode_ref ORDER BY m.start_date) AS rn
    FROM g_movements m
    WHERE m.ou_loc_ref IN ('E016', 'E103', 'E014', 'E015', 'E037', 'E057', 'E073', 'E043')
      AND m.start_date >= '2023-01-01'
      AND m.start_date < '2024-01-01'
      AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, m.start_date, m.end_date) > 1
),
filtered_movements AS (
    SELECT 
        episode_ref,
        patient_ref,
        start_date,
        end_date,
        ou_loc_ref,
        rn,
        LAG(end_date) OVER (PARTITION BY episode_ref ORDER BY rn) AS prev_end_date
    FROM valid_movements
),
filtered_movements_final AS (
    SELECT 
        episode_ref,
        patient_ref,
        start_date,
        end_date,
        ou_loc_ref,
        rn
    FROM filtered_movements
    WHERE end_date != prev_end_date
      OR prev_end_date IS NULL
),
nutrition_prescriptions AS (
    SELECT 
        p.episode_ref,
        p.patient_ref,
        p.start_date AS start_drug_date,
        p.code AS proc_code,
        p.descr AS drug_descr
    FROM g_procedures p
    WHERE p.episode_ref IN (SELECT episode_ref FROM filtered_movements_final)
      AND p.patient_ref IN (SELECT patient_ref FROM filtered_movements_final)
      AND p.code IN ('96.6', '99.15')
),
joined AS (
    SELECT 
        fm.episode_ref,
        fm.start_date,
        fm.end_date,
        np.start_drug_date,
        SUBSTRING(np.drug_descr, 1, LENGTH(np.drug_descr) - 1) AS drug_descr,
        TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, fm.start_date, np.start_drug_date) AS hours_difference,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fm.episode_ref, fm.patient_ref, fm.start_date, fm.end_date ORDER BY np.start_drug_date) AS rn_first
    FROM filtered_movements_final fm
    JOIN nutrition_prescriptions np ON fm.episode_ref = np.episode_ref AND fm.patient_ref = np.patient_ref
    WHERE np.start_drug_date >= fm.start_date
      AND np.start_drug_date <= fm.end_date
)
SELECT 
    episode_ref,
    start_date,
    start_drug_date,
    drug_descr,
    hours_difference
FROM joined
WHERE rn_first = 1
ORDER BY episode_ref, start_date
